I think Jokshan is one of the sons of Abraham. Abraham had several wives, including Sarah, and after Sarah's death, he married another woman. I believe her name was Hagar, but I've also heard her referred to as Keturah in some sources. I'm a bit confused about which name is correct, so I need to clarify that.

Looking up Genesis 25:1, it says that Abraham married Keturah after the death of Sarah. Keturah bore him six sons, including Jokshan. So, that would mean that Jokshan's father is Abraham, and after Sarah's death, Abraham married Keturah.

So, Keturah is the correct name of Abraham's second wife after Sarah. Therefore, Jokshan's father is Abraham, and he married Keturah after Sarah's death.
